Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

Stanley FatMax automatic wire stripper is ideal for professional electricians and skilled DIYers for precise wire preparation and termination during domestic or commercial electrical installations. The 203mm (8") multi-functional tool effortlessly cuts and strips inner and outer sheaths from 0.2-6mm cables and AWG wire. Features crimping capabilities and colour coding for crimping 1.5-6mm insulated and non-insulated terminals. The durable drop-forged steel blades ensure longevity, while the ergonomic bi-material soft-grip handles provide comfort and control during extended use, reducing hand fatigue on demanding jobs.
